The First Page
pages: On September 1, 2016, someone calling themselves naga uploaded an instrumental track called "gal games."
The original has been deleted. It survives only as a copy a fan archive uploaded to YouTube in 2021.
The same naga released a first EP, fezome, on New Year's Eve that year.

title: The Book of Too Many Names
pages: DJ GYROTTA ZAO. YABHIEL. ELIXIR NOMAD. tailandietis85.
Evil52Guard. swine antarctica. Dj Ernest Bykov.
LAMIANAGA was his Memphis rap side project.
Aox Ofwar is an umbrella over several of his SoundCloud accounts. One of them, named in hieroglyphs, held recordings of everyday life and neoclassical darkwave improvisations.
Fans keep an incomplete list of the names under a Last.fm tag called "Eck tatoo bleck tattooing."

title: Azeroy
pages: Azeroy is his fictional world, with its own language and script: Azeroyyska.
It was told through a YouTube series running from late 2018 to December 2021.
When the language is spoken there are English subtitles. Most of it has never been translated.
Fans have compared it all to an ARG. Some read Azeroy as an allegory for North Korea.
1616 means evil.
8888 means good.
Look at the titles. Azeroy Garden 8888. 8888Each Divinity. low-poly heaven 888.

title: Letters from the 2000s
pages: His visuals and lyrics borrow from 2000s games: Tekken, Counter-Strike 1.6, Runescape, flash games.
The Azeroy aesthetic draws on Web 2.0 iconography, like grainy 144p footage recorded with Unregistered HyperCam.

title: The Borrowed Melody
pages: FLASH CASANOVA samples "LEASE" by Japanese composer Takeshi Abo.
It comes from My Merry May, a visual novel from 2002.

title: Roots and Echoes
pages: According to Pitchfork writer Kieran Press-Reynolds, the music carries traces of the internet rap collective Reptilian Club Boyz and producer $ludgehammer.
It is often compared to Bladee and SpaceGhostPurrp.
In turn, he has influenced 2hollis and Ken Carson. Russian producer Dayerteq names him as an inspiration.

title: The Ghost
pages: As far as anyone knows, he has never given an interview.
Never performed live.
Released only a single piece of merch.

title: The Great Erasure
pages: Early 2021. He wiped his entire discography from SoundCloud and moved into hardstyle as DJ GYROTTA ZAO.
January 30, 2023. He deleted his main page and DJ GYROTTA ZAO. Soon after, LAMIANAGA.
Many believed he would never return.
One article says his growing frustration with his songs going viral on TikTok was a factor.

title: 24 Days
pages: March 25, 2024. He resurfaced with an untitled mix on the account ligonis24.
After 24 days, all three of his remaining accounts were gone.
Since then he has appeared on other accounts through 2024 and 2025, with short silences in between.

title: The Mirror Book
pages: He made songs private, made them public again, and uploaded parody versions of his own music.
In December 2022 came DESIRE, a parody of his own FLASH DESIRE from 2019.

title: Boing
pages: Yabujincore: jumpstyle clips on TikTok, Arabic and Russian text drifting across dreamlike scenes.
The most viral one, a Roblox figure dancing jumpstyle to a DJ GYROTTA ZAO track, was posted on November 21, 2022. Over 1.2 million views.
The comment sections filled with "boing :3".

title: The Archivists
pages: r/YABUJIN was founded on November 18, 2020.
FLASH DESIRE lives on as a re-upload on the SoundCloud account YABUJIN ARCHIVE. Fans keep a shared masterdoc cataloguing everything he has made.
CHALICE OF MIND was deleted and re-uploaded by fans. Like so many others.
This library is just one more archive.

title: Laumių Dovanos
pages: The EP Laumių Dovanos was released on June 28, 2025.
The title is Lithuanian. It means roughly "Gifts of the Laumės."
Laumės are female supernatural beings in Lithuanian folklore.

title: The Unanswered Letter
pages: Among his songs is one called DEAR GATEKEEPER.
Someone wrote a letter to the guardian.
No reply has come. Yet.

title: ,,,,Dear Gatekeeper,,,,
pages: Dear Gatekeeper,
I counted sixteen, sixteen, and the lights turned red.
I counted eighty-eight, eighty-eight, and the garden answered.
Between the two is a room with no floor. They call it 1688. They call it waiting.
You kept the door. I kept the key, inside a song nobody can find anymore.
If a page is empty, it was never deleted. It was only planted.
BPM OIZLMV ZMUMUJMZA
— azeroy1688
